data.name: SBL v0.1.0 — STANDALONE FOUNDATION PREVIEW
data.body:
## SBL v0.1.0 — STANDALONE FOUNDATION PREVIEW

**This is a foundation preview, not a general Skill/Agent builder.** What ships is the shared core,
the `sbl-todo` CLI and the machinery around them; what does not ship is a host-installed plugin set,
a native PIPD writer, or a generator that can produce arbitrary Skills and Agents.

### What you can actually do with it

```
pip install sbl_v01-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl
sbl-todo --data-dir ./todo init
sbl-todo --data-dir ./todo add --title "ship the foundation preview"
sbl-todo --data-dir ./todo list --json
sbl-todo --data-dir ./todo uninstall --yes
```

State persists across processes; nothing is sent over the network; the uninstall refuses to delete a
data directory that contains files it does not own.

### Artefacts

| File | Bytes | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|
| `sbl_v01-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl` | 27181 | `95e57c44614d9480673ebd7834293beda0dab3bb5e0c8851d5a6dd4460cd7c50` |
| `sbl_v01-0.1.0.tar.gz` | 36278 | `5babefeb0aee7eaeade692ef8bdeee85ab2e0021ed044c31819fdde3215bf15d` |

Both are built from `bedc11957d4fc2474b249b69d200829272c118ef` (default `main`), not from a working
tree, and the clean-install lifecycle was verified: fresh 3.11 venv, `--no-index` install, the CLI run
across process boundaries, uninstall, residue scan with no `sbl_*` module and no console script left.

### Scope and claims

- Mode: `STANDALONE_ONLY`. `PREW3_SHADOW` is read-only by construction; `SWOF_CONNECTED` refuses without
  a signed native ACK.
- Acceptance: the merge gate was an **owner self-review** (`HUMAN_PROCEDURAL_ACCEPTANCE`), because the
  mandated independent checker could not run this code (its transport answers 426, and the fallback
  carrier was cut by a provider content filter). It is **not** `INDEPENDENT_CASE_PASS`.
- Not included: the three host-installed plugins (`HOST_PENDING`), the HGK harness, the PIPD native
  writers, the 149 child requirements, the 38 delivery surfaces, the 441 donor identities.
- Licence: MIT (`LICENSE`, `NOTICE`, `SHIPPED_MATERIAL_INVENTORY.md`).

### Verify it yourself

```
git clone https://github.com/shw097-team/SBL && cd SBL
python -m pytest -q          # 148 passed on this tag
python tools/run_gates.py    # 11/11 exit 0
python tools/secret_scan.py --root .
sha256sum sbl_v01-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl
```

commit.message:
fix(sbl): close the two defects the second checker reproduced before its turn was cut

Receipt SBLR2-VERIFY-16 never completed: the provider flagged the checker's own adversarial work as
cybersecurity-risky and killed the turn, after which the dispatcher's retry hit the known websocket 426.
Its transcript nevertheless recorded two reproduced escapes, and both are real.

V16-BRIDGE-01 — junction swap between validation and write. The real-path check and the open were two
different instants, so replacing an allowed directory with a link in between escaped the writeset. apply()
now resolves once more immediately before opening, writes to the RESOLVED path rather than the literal one,
and after writing verifies that the file landed inside the real root, removing it and refusing if it did not.
Test: a monkeypatched re-resolution that returns an outside path must NACK and leave nothing behind.

V16-MODE-02 — signature collision. The HMAC material was the three fields joined by a bare separator, so
("issuer","a\x1fB","C") and ("issuer","a","B\x1fC") produced the same digest and therefore interchangeable
ACK signatures. The material is now length-prefixed. Test asserts the two tuples no longer collide.

Local: 11/11 gates exit 0, 148 passed (CORE 47, MODES 14, KNOW 15), scanner CLEAN 195 files.

data.title: c3 round 2: portable plugin manifests, the wheel that shipped without its data, and two installable surfaces
data.body:
Round 4 narrow repair of `F-R4-C3-PLUGIN-SCHEMA-001`, plus two installable surfaces.

**What was wrong.** `plugin_manifest()` emitted `"schema": "SBL-AGENT-PLUGIN/1"` with no `$schema`,
and put `identity` / `permissions` / `forbidden` / `claim_ceiling` at the top level. The portable
Agent Plugins 1.0.0 schema sets `additionalProperties: false` and requires `$schema` and `name`, so no
conforming host could recognise these packages.

**What changed.** The manifest is now `{$schema, name, version, description, license, keywords,
extensions}`, with principal metadata under `extensions["org.sbl.principal"]`. Every package is
validated against a vendored copy of the published schema before the ZIP is closed, and validator
non-vacuity is proven by injection (missing/foreign `$schema`, extra top-level key, the legacy
`schema` key, illegal name pattern, non-object extension, unknown author key).

**A second defect, found by the Docker sandbox and not by any local test:** the wheel shipped without
`sbl_sp/manifests/*.json`, so every `load_manifest` call in an *installed* package raised
`SBL_E_UNKNOWN_SP` while the source tree was green — CI ran `pip install -e .`, which resolves data
files straight from the source tree. `package-data` is fixed and `tools/check_wheel_contents.py` now
builds the real wheel in CI and asserts its members.

**New surfaces.** `sbl_stack` (install / doctor / selftest / status / uninstall over the composed
M01..M06 core, with an integrity manifest of the exact bytes it validated) and `sbl_harness` (pinned
HGK dependency + harness ABI + probe / install / doctor / uninstall; it declares the native boundary
rather than crossing it).

**Ceiling.** `PACKAGED_HOST_PENDING`. Three packages were installed and loaded by a real host loader
on one machine, with a rollback point taken first; no host-issued plugin identity was obtained and no
independent checker signed. Merge is an owner act and does not raise the ceiling.

183 tests, 11/11 gates, secret scan CLEAN, CI 2/2 on ubuntu + windows 3.11 (run 39525131900).

Evidence: `evidence/r4-20261021-c4` — `_governance/round-20261021-r4/` (contract, five-tool matrix,
sandbox receipt, rollback manifest, install receipt, SWOF shadow handoff, CR, corrections).
